exercises.instruction: Which continents are these countries in?
items: Example: Thailand Thailand is in Asia.

exercises.instruction: Are these sentences true or false? If they are false, correct them.
items: Example: Rome is the capital of Canada.
False: Rome is the capital of Italy.
1 Ottawa is the capital of the USA.
2 Dublin is the capital of Australia.
3 Lima is the capital of Peru.
4 London is the capital of Sweden.
5 Madrid is the capital of Russia.
6 Pretoria is the capital of Korea.
7 Canberra is the capital of Austria.
8 Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
9 Wellington is the capital of Chile.
10 Washington DC is the capital of the USA.
